framework.name: Lintel
framework.summary: Rust desktop framework with a small public facade, pinned public renderer, optional services and application-owned tools.

entry_points.summary: Native single-window State/Message/update/view application; set an explicit reverse-DNS id.
Native managed windows, ordinary typed messages and tasks.
Fallible native initialization with AppContext after plugins and services start.
Fallible contextual native boot with WindowManager and initial Task.
Embedded local pages, typed/async bridge commands, independent window sessions.
Provider-neutral typed tool registry, explicit grants, bounded execution/progress and existing task-scope cancellation.
ProcessHost, typed service directory/calls, worker entry and explicit trusted native runtime.
Weak scoped services and trusted page metadata; native ingress generation and admission start gate reject stale queued work.
Bounded absolute-deadline readiness and later-attempt waits using existing snapshots and events; no RPC replay.
Immediately submit typed discovery and bind one owned Send client; retain routed generation, original deadline, quota and default-deny policy. No automatic reconnect or replay.
Validate declared service shape, all binary targets and application self-reference before compiling; preserve single-target build and prebuilt bundle paths.
Opt-in worker-native capture before Mojo load; preserve the ordinary worker contract and record fixed service identity/supervisor attempt.
Reuse local native reporter with validated service correlation metadata; no arbitrary fields, endpoint capture or upload.

features.name: public-iced
features.summary: Default pinned public iced/winit integration from the vendored source tree.
features.validation_boundary: macOS native evidence and selected Windows/Linux target checks; individual platform acceptance differs.

features.name: public-cef
features.validation_boundary: macOS arm64 native evidence; Windows API_ONLY/static SDK checks only, native packaging remains gated.

features.name: desktop
features.summary: Main-thread native owner with awaitable thread-safe services; permissions, activation and accessibility.
features.validation_boundary: Linux needs explicit optional backends; no universal permission/session fallback.

features.name: services
features.summary: Store, capability-bound files, network policy and diagnostics plugins.
features.validation_boundary: Model/local-fixture tests do not replace each OS runtime acceptance.

features.name: sqlite
features.summary: Dedicated worker, bounded admission and transactional migrations.
features.validation_boundary: Bundled Windows C build needs a matching MSVC SDK.

features.name: updater
features.summary: Signed releases, external helpers and protected managed installation.
features.validation_boundary: Windows native file sharing/ACL/Registry/installer behavior remains unaccepted.

features.name: crash-reporting
features.summary: Optional local native crash helper; also forwards worker capture only when multiprocess is enabled. CEF Crashpad remains an alternate browser backend.
features.validation_boundary: Backend runtime configuration is exclusive; native helper and dump evidence is platform-specific.

features.name: linux-desktop
features.summary: Explicit SNI tray, X11 and user-mediated portal shortcut backends.
features.validation_boundary: Protocol fixtures and target checks exist; real user desktop/provider acceptance remains open.

features.name: agent
features.summary: Application-owned tool execution; no model vendor or transport enabled by default.
features.validation_boundary: Typed serialization, policy, bounds and cooperative cancellation require explicit application integration; not an in-process sandbox.

features.name: multiprocess
features.summary: Optional typed Mojo local service processes with supervised lifecycle and explicit native runtime.
features.validation_boundary: macOS arm64 native UI and CEF/JS joint service runs, scoped cancellation, restart/reconnect and cleanup accepted; Windows/Linux target checks only. Trusted matching native image required; not an OS sandbox.

crate_areas.summary: Public facade and high-level runtime integration.
AppContext, plugin lifecycle, typed service store and managed tasks.
Existing program FIFO and renderer integration.
Embedded CEF WebView widget and OSR integration.
Thread-confined native owner and safe service interfaces.
Scaffolding, build/package/signing and distribution verification library.
Installed CLI and embedded portable framework archive.
Release verification, helpers and managed installation.
Dedicated Mojo supervision thread, typed directory and worker lifecycle; no GUI dependency.

templates.name: native
templates.summary: Minimal native State/Message application with one direct lintel dependency.
templates.validation_boundary: Resolve the initial app lock entry before --locked; zero tests are not application behavior evidence. Linux may run via Cargo, while CLI packaging/run support differs.

templates.name: webview
templates.summary: Embedded local WebView page and Rust command bridge.
templates.validation_boundary: CEF SDK/resources are real prerequisites. Compile, bundle load and native renderer acceptance are separate checks.

templates.name: windows-webview
templates.summary: Experimental official CEF bootstrap App.dll starter.
templates.validation_boundary: API_ONLY is neither SDK link nor bootstrap/sandbox execution. No default run or packaging pass is implied.

templates.name: multiprocess
templates.summary: Native UI plus independent typed Mojo Echo service and shared protocol crate.
templates.validation_boundary: Native execution requires an explicitly supplied trusted matching Mojo SDK 0.3.0 library; target checks are not native acceptance.

templates.name: webview-multiprocess
templates.summary: Local CEF page calling an independently supervised typed Mojo Echo service.
templates.validation_boundary: macOS arm64 native JS/Mojo, relocated prebuilt delivery, long16.2s command, host/client timeout+abort, multiwindow/restart/cancel/readback accepted. Tests use mock keychain; Windows/Linux target checks only.

commands.summary: Emit this embedded versioned catalog without host probes.
commands.validation_boundary: Framework discovery, not doctor/host validation or execution permission.

commands.summary: Generate a native, WebView or multiprocess consumer and portable framework; reject template-specific worker/protocol name collisions.
commands.validation_boundary: The current generator runs on macOS hosts. Template platforms name consumer targets, not generator host support. New or empty destination only; validate the consumer on its actual target.

commands.summary: Prepare the pinned public dependency source for a framework checkout.
commands.validation_boundary: Dependency preparation is not compilation or native acceptance.

commands.summary: Preflight all declared service targets, then build the selected application and its service binaries with the same configuration.
commands.validation_boundary: Matching target toolchain and actual native dependencies required.
Supported native host only; forwarded application arguments remain data.

commands.summary: Validate and produce a native app/portable artifact.
commands.validation_boundary: Windows CEF packaging is gated; signing is explicit.

commands.summary: Verify a signed complete offline tree with an independent trusted public key.
commands.validation_boundary: Ed25519 byte authenticity is not Authenticode chain trust or native installation.

commands.summary: Plan by default; explicit execute produces a signed immutable offline directory.
commands.validation_boundary: Never modify payload after signing; private signing key stays outside artifact.

commands.summary: Inspect by default; explicit execute consumes the protected verified snapshot.
Build declared service binaries, verify/package an explicit native Mojo image, then run the application.
commands.validation_boundary: No default runtime download; target/platform and existing signing checks apply. A provided binary remains a trusted-code decision.

commands.summary: Package the dedicated lintel-worker-crash-helper role with existing native image and publication checks.
commands.validation_boundary: Copies an explicitly selected trusted helper; does not install a reporter. Can coexist with CEF Crashpad in a different process; browser reporter conflict remains.

platform_limits: Windows/Linux native desktop/provider/install acceptance remains incomplete.
Windows CEF API_ONLY/static archive checks do not establish SDK loading, sandbox or packaging.
Screen-reader speech, visible notification, clipboard write and native global shortcut delivery are not all accepted.
A model, schema, catalog or accepted queue request does not grant permissions or prove completed business work.
